hero.intro: I work on the Ford Credit mobile app, previous co-lead a 250-member college graduate program at Ford, and spend my off hours volunteering for FIRST Robotics, Senior High Ministry at Calvary Chapel, and my family.

site.bioTeaser: Born and raised in Bensalem, Pennsylvania, I'm trying to give back to the community that helped me grow up. By day I'm an iOS developer at Ford Credit; the rest of my time goes to working out, volunteering, serving at my church and working Eagles game days.
